    CodeAffichageDéfinitionFrench (fr)
    activeActiveThe subject is currently experiencing the condition or situation, there is evidence of the condition or situation, or considered to be a significant risk.Active
    resolvedResolvedThe subject is not presently experiencing the condition or situation and there is a negligible perceived risk of the condition or situation returning.Résolue

name: TaussigConditionClinicalStatusVS
title: TAUSSIG — Statut clinique d'une condition évolutive
description: Statut clinique d'une condition cardiaque évolutive au moment du cathétérisme : active ou résolue (décision B1). Distinct de l'état d'annotation « explicitement absent », qui signifie que la condition n'existe pas.
